children: STOCKHOLM (dpa-AFX) - Hennes & Mauritz AB (HEN.L) released a profit for its third quarter that Increased, from the same period last year
The company's bottom line totaled SEK4.123 billion, or SEK2.58 per share.  This compares with SEK3.229 billion, or SEK2.01 per share, last year.
The company's revenue for the period rose 0.3% to SEK57.189 billion from SEK57.017 billion last year.
Hennes & Mauritz AB earnings at a glance (GAAP) :
-Earnings: SEK4.123 Bln. vs. SEK3.229 Bln. last year.
-Revenue: SEK57.189 Bln vs. SEK57.017 Bln last year.
